mutationSemantics.ambiguousOutcome: reread actual state; preserve drafts; never automatically replay
mutationSemantics.statusSource: manual table plus native handlers and dependency/completion gates

websocket.malformedBoardNative: normalizes to absent; client must reject before transport
websocket.hostedPluginIsolation: WebSockets unsupported in host-buffered plugin mode

skills.catalogLimit: API exposes loadable visible entries, not full shadowed/ambiguous catalog or complete platform selection; obtain native readers for missing fields, never infer effective session skills
skills.sameTier: ambiguous unless provably same skill and unique best rank; shadowed entries excluded from find_all_skills
skills.agentLabel: includes hand-authored local skills; not proof AI-created
skills.selection: skills.disabled union platform_disabled; explicit platform > HERMES_PLATFORM > session HERMES_SESSION_PLATFORM; essential skills subtracted by prompt-index helper
skills.effective: unknown without actual session/platform snapshot; API enabled is configured global selection, not effective loadability

profiles.markerRule: any regular file or symlink; dangling marker symlink still identity
profiles.excluded: default named dir, invalid ID, markerless dir, tombstone in profiles/.deleted/name

cron.identityAuthority: owner-scoped raw jobs.json; do not use profile=all or cross-owner fallback
cron.skillsPrecedence: skills when not null (including [] or empty string); otherwise legacy skill; string -> singleton; scheduler trims and removes blank entries; jobs loader additionally deduplicates
cron.toolsets: enabled_toolsets not null overrides cron platform config; [] means zero including MCP; nonempty merges enabled MCP; config denylist still applies; config read error fails closed
cron.model: job.model > cron.model > main model default/model/name > HERMES_MODEL; missing error; provider job pin > cron.model_provider > persisted runtime
cron.script: no_agent executes script only; other jobs use script output as prompt context; workdir invalid -> no cwd override; paths never executed by inspector
cron.effective: authored vs inherited distinct; per-fire runtime/source snapshot needed for effective values

activity.historicalMissing: unknown attribution; never fill from current assignee/run owner
activity.readContract: separate read-only SQLite snapshot; never plugin _conn (it init_db/migrates)
activity.privacy: structural whitelist only; no task body/prompt/comments

apiOnlyFields.note: API supports these; no claim that InlineCreate/ModelEditor/StatusActions/RunHistorySection currently renders matching controls. Todo is available through board drag/bulk; review/scheduled are not direct native drawer controls. Do not add new UI as a parity requirement.
